planningGeometryLead.geometryStatus: reviewed as attributed exploratory catchment context only; no geometry added to the app
planningGeometryLead.areaDefinitionConflict: University of Glasgow Pampanga catchment polygon attribute is 7842.332 km2; PAGASA reports about 10540 km2 for Pampanga Basin including the allied Guagua basin. Definitions/extents are unreconciled.
planningGeometryLead.decision: Dataset omissions are not evidence that a waterbody or catchment is absent. Catchments are not fish sites, municipal-water boundaries, waterbody inventories, or river-reach geometry.

coverageGaps: The reported 168-unit planning count has not been reconciled to a named, versioned inventory.
No authoritative waterbody geometry or complete municipal/city crosswalk is validated; the reviewed national catchment dataset is planning context only.
Coastal, estuarine and brackish study-area identities remain incomplete.
Aurora, Bulacan, Nueva Ecija, Pampanga, Tarlac and Zambales require additional source-reviewed fish records beyond the named leads.
Regional species coverage, historical/current distinctions, taxonomy, locality precision, rights and safety information remain incomplete.

nextStep.action: Continue the Central Luzon freshwater sweep at Paitan Lake and Vaca Dam Reservoir, separating the 2021 stocking event from wild/catch evidence. Then expand named river, lake, wetland, estuarine, brackish and coastal source review across all seven provinces. Pantabangan's 2026 nine-species abstract and historic surveys remain research-only pending full taxon/accession, specimen, locality and rights checks. Bataan rows remain held with no independent identity verification, rights clearance, public assertions, or app projections.
